The '''line squad''', also known as an '''infantry squad''', was the basic deployment unit of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A line [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was comprised of eight [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] led by a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] experimented with ways to increase the combat effectiveness of the basic line squad following setbacks against the insurgent [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. One major effort was the issuing of a [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]] to each squad. Rearming line squads was sporadic, but more than half of the squads deployed to the [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy]], [[Harron sector/Legends|Harron]] and [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sectors]] were outfitted with a light repeating blaster per squad, with all squads on [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|Uviuy Exen]] and [[Trammen]] being armed as such.<ref name="ISB" /> A light mechanized infantry squad could be comprised of personnel operating four [[MobileMortar-3]] units.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
